summary: Frontend-only retest of Redesign R3 (Today, Live sheet, Insights, match page) at 1920x800 and 390x844, light and dark. All 7 retest fixes verified: (1) 10 quick page loads gave 0 x 429 (282x200) and Insights loads; (2) focus stays on ins-min-high for 5 ArrowRight presses (55->75) on desktop and 3 on phone; (3) 'Forecasts (9)' matches the 9 cards rendered at the 50% default; (4) pitch shows 11+11 with unique testids on the upcoming and finished match; (5) no Live tab on upcoming (Preview default) or finished (Recap default); (6) ins-league-30/10/61/47 chips show names and filter (PL -> Tottenham cards only, aria-pressed true); (7) clicking the track moves the single-thumb slider (10% -> 55, 90% -> 90); aria-current=date on the selected day in Today and Insights; Today league header '5 matches · 5 insights'; Today row columns line up (same x for all rows). Phone: no horizontal page overflow on Today, Insights or any tab of both match pages; a swipe left/right on the list changes the day (+1/-1), a 30px swipe does nothing; chip rows scroll sideways; More filters sheet works (position, venue, reset, scrim close). Dark mode renders well on all three screens at both sizes. Live sheet with a mocked /api/live (LIVE + Scheduled + FT): header-live-pill (desktop) and live-pill (phone) say '1 live' and open the sheet titled 'Live now · 1'; the live card links to the match and closes the sheet; Later today, Finished (1) toggle and All scores today -> /live work; changing the score on the next poll added is-flash (after about 57s). Following chip (test user following Inter) shows 'Following 1' and only Venezia v Inter; it shows today-empty/today-show-all on a day with no followed games. Empty state on 2027-07-01 shows today-next-day, which moves to 07-02. Issues are listed below; none block use.

minor.issue: Inter (team_iid 45) for match bde08683 has 15 predicted starters for a 3-5-2 (4 DEF, 7 MID, 3 FWD). Several share the same pitch_x/pitch_y (Akanji and Bastoni 0.36/0.5; Thuram and Esposito 0.87/0.7; Sucic and Mkhitaryan 0.61/0.31). Venezia has 12. The frontend's slice(0,11) hides the count, but the eleven shown is Inter with 4 at the back in a 3-5-2 and two pairs of players stacked on the same spot (names overlap).

ui_bugs.issue: The cap keeps the first 11 in API order, not the 11 most likely to start. On the upcoming match, Akanji/Bastoni and Thuram/Esposito are drawn on top of each other with overlapping names. Sort by p_play (pp map) before slice(0,11), and/or move players that share a spot. The real fix is in the backend predicted XI.

The time runs into the team names ('05:30 PMAC Milan v Bologna'). Cause: .ls-mini time {width:52px} is too narrow for 12-hour '05:30 PM' (about 62px), so it overflows and uses up the 12px gap. Use min-width instead of width (or about 72px). The /live phone overlap reported in iter 22 looks like the same cause.

At 390px the floating '1 live' pill sits on top of the cookie banner's 'No thanks' button (pill at y 722-766, over the button), so it covers that button until the banner is dismissed. Raise the cookie banner's z-index above the pill, or move the pill up while the banner shows.

At the minimum value the tip ('50%') is cut off at the left edge in the phone More filters sheet and on the match Forecasts slider (tip left = 13px with translateX(-50%) on a tip about 40px wide). Clamp the tip position or drop the translate at the ends.

integration_issues.issue: The LiveSheet.jsx comment and docs say it polls every 30 s while open, but Layout calls useLiveNow() without fast=true, so it polls every 60 s even when open (the flash came about 57 s after the change). Also, is-flash and the lift to the top only end on the next re-render; nothing re-renders after 30 s, so the flash can stay up to 60 s.
Two /api/live requests on first load (2 calls before the first 60 s tick). Small waste.

issues: theme-toggle is only in the footer on phone (hidden in the header), so it is hard to find.
When a date beyond the 7-day strip is picked with the calendar, no day is highlighted and the chosen date is not shown anywhere (the calendar button shows only an icon). Show the picked date.
'Top 3 for today' with only 1 card plus 'See all 1 →' (signed out, insights capped) looks thin. Consider 'Top pick' when there are fewer than 3.
The day strip and 4 chip rows push the first card to about y=550 of 844. Consider merging Tier/Market/League into one scrolling row or collapsing them.
The k-badge aria-label is '{count} selected', which is wrong for Today counts ('All 5' is read as '5 selected'). Use '{count} matches' or a label passed in.
The brand name fallback in Layout.jsx is misspelled: 'Prediciotn'.

action_items: Backend predicted XI: return exactly 11 per side that match the formation, with unique pitch spots; in the frontend Pitch, sort by p_play before slice(0,11)
Fix the overlap between the floating live-pill and the cookie banner buttons on phone (z-index/offset)
Clamp the RangeSlider tip at the ends so it is not cut off
Pass useLiveNow(liveOpen) so it polls every 30 s while the sheet is open, and re-render to clear is-flash after 30 s
Chip badge aria-label; footer 'Prediciotn' typo; show a calendar-picked date in the DateScroller
critical_code_review_comments: Match.jsx Pitch: dedupe/cap logic hides bad data instead of picking the likeliest XI
LiveSheet: the comment says 30 s while open but the code never passes fast; useFlash's time check only runs on render
Today.jsx Top3 calls /insights?limit=200 and filters on the client; Insights does the same, so the same payload is fetched twice when moving between pages (useApi cache aside)

Today swipe handler is on the list wrapper, so a sideways scroll of the chips/top3 carousel does not trigger it (good), but a horizontal pan inside a long row could change the day; consider checking |dy| < |dx|

success_rate.frontend: 95% (all requested flows pass; 4 minor UI bugs)

test_credentials: test_e1_user / test_e1_admin recreated with backend/tests/recreate_test_users.py and deleted afterwards with backend/tests/iter15_cleanup.py (user, follow, session, auth_log and events rows removed). The owner was not used.
seed_data_creation: None kept. The test user followed Inter during the test; the follow was removed by the cleanup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: App clock is 2026-10-28. There are 5 Serie A fixtures today, all Scheduled, so nothing is really live; to test the live sheet, intercept /api/live?... with a payload {live_count, leagues:[{league, fixtures:[{sid, match_id, status LIVE|Scheduled|FT, minute, kickoff, home:{name,team}, away, score:{home,away}, events_n}]}]} and also /api/live/{sid}/events. Polling runs every 60 s. Signed out, /api/insights returns 20 items across 4 leagues. Match bde08683 = Venezia v Inter (upcoming, 9 cards >= 50%); 0e531123 = Torino 1-3 Como (final). Slider testids are <testid>-high (single thumb). The phone theme toggle is in the footer.
rca of the issue: Live sheet text overlap: matchday.css:69 fixes .ls-mini time at width 52px, while toLocaleTimeString in 12-hour locales gives '05:30 PM' (about 62px); the flex item overflows into the 12px gap. Pitch overlap: the API sends more than 11 predicted starters with duplicate coordinates; the frontend keeps the first 11 in API order.
